description: RugRadar rug check / rug pull checker: 0-100 risk score with plain reasons and a buyer summary for a token on Solana (incl. pump.fun), BNB, Base, Ethereum or Arbitrum. $0.01 per check: 45+ data points per token, including 16 signals RugCheck's free report doesn't show (dev-sold %, sniper and launch-bundle share, a live can-you-sell quote, the creator's past launches, volume vs market cap, bot-trading score), across 5 chains.

api_key.description: optional RugRadar credit key (or send header X-RugRadar-Key)

chain.description: default solana; 0x addresses default to base

token.description: Solana mint or EVM 0x token contract

name: rug_check
